versionControl.reason: This project directory is not a git repository (verified with `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`). No commit hash exists to record. The baseline is therefore pinned by content hashes plus a source fingerprint.
versionControl.sourceFingerprintMethod: sha256 of the newline-joined `sha256sum` output of every *.ts/*.tsx/*.mjs file under src/, remotion/ and scripts/, sorted by path

hashes.enforceByteIdentityRationale: grid.bin, film-spec.json, shot-list.json and contact-sheet.png are produced entirely by deterministic engine code, so byte identity is a meaningful invariant and is enforced. The two MP4s depend on the libx264 build shipped inside @remotion/compositor-darwin-arm64; a toolchain upgrade could legitimately change the bitstream without changing a single frame. Their byte hashes are recorded for change detection but the enforced gates are structural (frame count, duration, fps, resolution, codec, full decode) — see the decode requirements below.
